# /crav1-complete-task

[All skills](../skills.md) · Walkthrough: [Build tasks](../../from-plan-to-build.md) · Playbook: [`SKILL.md`](../../../.cursor/skills/crav1/crav1-complete-task/SKILL.md)

## Purpose

Start one T# implement-to-done in an isolated worker chat (subagent).

Isolated worker for one `T#`: implement → commit → verify → optional fix; persist commit style as a rule.

When a local test dependency is not running, the worker returns `needs_dependency` with a `BLOCKER:` line, and you answer start, skip, or stop.

## Runs when

One task through commit in a worker. Called by the user.

## Reads

In short: One `T#` and the persist rule.

Reads one `T#` and the persist rule.

## Writes

In short: The commit-style rule when it is missing; its worker writes that task's code, `tasks.md`, `verify.md`, `fix-log.md` when a fix runs, and the commits.

Writes the commit-style rule when it is missing.

## Does not

Leaves product code, `spec.md`, push, and the pull request alone in this chat.

Limits and exceptions: it does not ask to run [`/crav1-keep-current`](crav1-keep-current.md).

## You run next / Runs by itself

- You run next: [`/crav1-open-pr`](crav1-open-pr.md)
- Runs by itself: Calls [`/crav1-feature-branch`](crav1-feature-branch.md) and `crav1-complete-task-agent`.
